title: Richard Hicks Appointed Aston Martin Reserve Driver
caption: Richard Hicks in a BMW M and Schubert Motorsport racing suit.
body:
Aston Martin has announced that Australian driver Richard Hicks will join the squad as its reserve driver for the 2024 season, revealed on a breaking‑news graphic that shows him in a racing suit bearing the BMW M, Schubert Motorsport and XGT logos.

Hicks races under number 24 and is currently contracted to drive for Schubert Motorsport in the XGT series. He has not yet recorded a race result in the league, but his role with the BMW M‑branded Schubert entry gives him experience with high‑performance machinery.

Aston Martin competes in the F1 series and sits third in the 2024 constructors' standings with 121 points, having achieved one win and two podiums so far. The team’s primary driver line‑up features Gunner Tai and Jacob Vavro, overseen by team principal Ethan Aston, with junior drivers Gideon Lettink and Kaizer Navarro also in the program. Adding Hicks as a reserve expands the squad’s depth and links the F1 operation with the XGT feeder series.
